credential_capture.label: Amazon sign-in details
credential_capture.description: Seal the Amazon sign-in details for this source. The connector uses them only for this source's browser-backed collection.
credential_capture.submit_label: Save Amazon credential and start first sync

refresh_policy.rationale: Sign-in and anti-bot checks are common on first login, but the session persists in the owner's browser profile afterward, so scheduled refresh reuses it. background_safe:true records that persistence and recommended_mode follows from it. assisted_after_owner_auth:true means a background run may still ask the owner for bounded help when Amazon re-challenges.

streams.name: orders
streams.description: Amazon retail orders scraped from Your Orders.

display.label: Your Amazon orders
display.detail: Order IDs, dates, totals, delivery status, shipping summaries, payment method summary, recipient name. Per-item breakdowns live in the order_items stream.

views.label: Fields for matching to bank/YNAB transactions

display.label: Your order line items
display.detail: Product titles, ASINs, per-unit prices, quantities, sellers, product URLs, item-level return/refund status.

streams.name: profile
streams.description: Best-effort account profile read from the Amazon nav bar (display name, Prime membership).

display.label: Your Amazon account
display.detail: Display name and Prime membership status, as shown in the Amazon nav bar. Both are null when not observable, never guessed.
